plan.comparison: Among affordable fixed settings maximize holdout passes, breaking ties by fewer paid lookups.
plan.gepaMetric: Exact pass plus field credit on failures below one full pass per complete panel.
plan.holdoutOrder: Every three-case combination with one seeded assignment of the other nine cases.
plan.precheck: Read incumbent qualification until the first miss or a complete pass panel. Cancel search only after a complete pass and reuse any read incumbent replies in ordinary qualification. Apply to all methods.
plan.scope: Holdout selects the retrospective control after replay. Ordinary search and qualification are unchanged.
